new_units.title: prism_subscription dispatcher scaffold
new_units.spec: Create prism_subscription dispatcher with action enum (webhook_receive, entitlement_grant, entitlement_revoke, tier_check, seat_allocate, seat_revoke, license_validate, dunning_advance, refund_process, audit_record), schema, lazy imports; wire to prism_session+prism_context+prism_dev per CLAUDE.md wire-to-all-sources law.
new_units.acceptance: Dispatcher registered in DISPATCHER_DIGEST.md; all 10 actions stub-routable; smoke test fires each action with empty payload returns structured error not crash.

new_units.title: Stripe webhook security primitives
new_units.spec: StripeSignatureVerifierEngine: HMAC-SHA256 verify against STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, raw-body middleware preservation, 300s replay-window enforcement, clock-skew tolerance +/-60s, idempotency-key dedup table (event.id PRIMARY KEY, 30d TTL).
new_units.acceptance: 5 adversarial tests pass: replayed event rejected, tampered amount rejected, wrong secret rejected, expired timestamp rejected, missing Stripe-Signature header rejected; idempotent re-delivery of same event.id increments dedup counter not entitlement.

new_units.title: Stripe webhook event handler dispatch
new_units.spec: StripeEventDispatchEngine routes verified events (checkout.session.completed, invoice.paid, customer.subscription.updated, customer.subscription.deleted, invoice.payment_failed, charge.dispute.created) to entitlement state transitions.
new_units.acceptance: Each event type has dedicated handler with explicit state-transition log; unknown event types logged and ack 200 (no retry storm); handler exceptions trigger Stripe automatic retry.

new_units.title: Paddle webhook RSA signature verifier
new_units.spec: PaddleSignatureVerifierEngine: RSA-SHA1 public-key verify (Paddle uses RSA not HMAC), separate event taxonomy mapper (Paddle->internal canonical event type), separate idempotency table (paddle alert_id). NOT a transparent Stripe fallback.
new_units.acceptance: Paddle test fixtures verify cleanly; mismatched signature rejected; Paddle alert_id collision with Stripe event.id namespace-isolated; event type mapping table covers Paddle subscription_created/updated/cancelled/payment_succeeded/payment_failed.

new_units.title: Stripe Tax bridge
new_units.spec: TaxCalcBridgeEngine: Stripe Tax API integration with nexus matrix config (state/shared/tax-nexus-matrix.json: per-jurisdiction nexus thresholds), automatic_tax=true on Stripe invoice/subscription creation, tax-id-collection enabled.
new_units.acceptance: Stripe Tax sandbox creates invoice in US-CA (10.25%), US-DE (0%), UK (20%), EU-DE (19%), AU (10%) with correct rate; nexus matrix loads from JSON with N-1 schema-version backward compat.

new_units.title: Invoice tax-line rendering
new_units.spec: InvoiceTaxRendererEngine: per-line-item tax breakdown on PDF + HTML invoice, multi-jurisdiction stacking (state+county+city), tax-exempt line annotation, VAT-MOSS quarterly summary export.
new_units.acceptance: Sample invoice for EU-B2C shows VAT line; sample for EU-B2B shows reverse-charge note + zero VAT; US-CA invoice shows state+county+city breakdown; MOSS export CSV validates against EU schema.

new_units.title: B2B VAT-ID validation
new_units.spec: VatIdValidatorEngine: VIES SOAP API for EU VAT, UK VAT lookup, fallback to Stripe Tax tax_ids verification, reverse-charge auto-apply on validated B2B EU cross-border, retain validation timestamp + response payload for audit (SOC2 evidence).
new_units.acceptance: Valid EU VAT-ID accepted, invalid rejected, VIES downtime falls back to format-regex with warning flag, cross-border B2B applies reverse-charge, validation snapshot persisted to audit log.

new_units.title: Tax-exempt customer flow
new_units.spec: TaxExemptFlowEngine: exemption certificate upload + admin review queue, per-jurisdiction exemption types (501c3, government, resale), exemption expiry tracking, retroactive credit on approved certificate.
new_units.acceptance: Admin approves certificate -> Stripe tax_exempt=exempt flips; expired certificate triggers re-collection; retroactive credit generates Stripe credit note for paid-with-tax invoices in window.

new_units.title: Currency rounding + reconciliation
new_units.spec: CurrencyRoundingEngine: banker's rounding (round-half-to-even) per ISO-4217 minor-unit, Stripe-compatible rounding policy, daily reconciliation report (PRISM totals vs Stripe payout totals) with drift alert >0.01 base unit.
new_units.acceptance: USD/EUR/GBP/CAD/AUD/JPY rounding tests match Stripe behavior; JPY has zero decimal places enforced; daily recon job emits drift report; >$0.01 drift triggers alert.

new_units.title: GDPR Art-17 delete cascade
new_units.spec: GdprDeleteCascadeEngine: orchestrates Stripe customer.deleted + PRISM user record + license tokens + tribal-tip authorship anonymization + audit-log redaction (with hash retained), 30-day soft-delete window, irreversible after window.
new_units.acceptance: Delete request creates DSR ticket; 30d window permits cancel; on commit cascade verified across 5 surfaces; audit log retains hashed evidence of erasure (proof of compliance) without PII; Stripe customer marked deleted via API.

new_units.title: SOC2 audit-log immutable chain
new_units.spec: AuditLogEngine: append-only table for every entitlement change (actor, timestamp, from_state, to_state, reason, request_id), hash-chain (each row hashes prev row + payload), tamper-evident verify endpoint, 7-year retention.
new_units.acceptance: Every tier_check/entitlement_grant/seat_allocate logs immutable row; hash-chain verify endpoint detects tampering of any historical row; retention policy enforced; SOC2 CC7.2 auditor sample-pull script produces signed report.

new_units.title: Audit-log retention + PII minimization
new_units.spec: AuditRetentionEngine: 7-year retention for financial events (SOX), 3-year for entitlement, PCI-DSS scope minimization (no raw PAN ever stored, only Stripe customer_id/payment_method tokens), automated retention purge with hash-chain re-anchoring on purge boundary.
new_units.acceptance: Retention scan job validates no event past TTL; PCI scope audit script confirms zero PAN/CVV/full-card storage; purge re-anchors hash chain so verification still works for retained window.

new_units.title: Proration engine (decoupled)
new_units.spec: ProrationEngine: pure-function mid-cycle plan-change math (credit unused period at old tier, charge prorated new tier), Stripe prorations API integration, day-boundary policy (UTC), preview-before-commit endpoint for UI.
new_units.acceptance: Unit tests: upgrade mid-month credits + charges balance; downgrade scheduled vs immediate paths both correct; Stripe preview API mirrored locally; preview returns invoice-item array matching Stripe.

new_units.title: Plan-change downgrade state machine
new_units.spec: PlanChangeStateEngine: immediate vs end-of-cycle downgrade, seat-shuffle policy on multi-seat downgrade (LIFO by activation date with admin-override), entitlement-revoke timing per tier, scheduled-change cancellation window.
new_units.acceptance: Downgrade 10-seat to 5-seat with no admin pick revokes 5 most-recently-added; admin override accepted via API; scheduled change cancellable until 1h before effective; revoke triggers offline-token CRL update.

new_units.title: Grandfather pricing table + reactivation window
new_units.spec: GrandfatherTableEngine: state/shared/grandfather-pricing.json with schemaVersion + N-1 compat, reactivation window (default 60d) preserves grandfather rate, beyond window forces current rate; admin force-grandfather override with audit-log entry.
new_units.acceptance: Cancel-then-resubscribe within 60d retains old price; beyond 60d uses current; admin override logged immutably; schema version bump migration tested.

new_units.title: Refund math + entitlement revoke atomicity
new_units.spec: RefundMathEngine: full vs partial refund proration, atomic refund+revoke transaction (both succeed or both rollback), prepaid-annual partial refund credits remaining months, idempotent on Stripe refund webhook re-delivery.
new_units.acceptance: Full refund revokes entitlement immediately; 50% refund prorates entitlement to remaining 50%; failure mid-transaction rolls back both; webhook duplicate refund event no-op.

new_units.title: Chargeback evidence pipeline
new_units.spec: ChargebackEvidenceEngine: auto-assembles Stripe Radar dispute evidence (customer signup IP, license usage logs, invoice PDFs, support tickets) within 7-day Stripe deadline, submits via dispute.update API, tracks win/loss outcome metric.
new_units.acceptance: Dispute webhook triggers evidence gather job; assembled bundle submitted before deadline; win-rate metric tracked; replay test on synthetic dispute completes pipeline end-to-end.

new_units.title: Annual-to-monthly credit conversion
new_units.spec: CreditConversionEngine: converts unused annual balance to Stripe credit_balance on plan downgrade, applies credit against future monthly invoices first, surfaces credit-remaining in customer portal.
new_units.acceptance: Annual $1200 downgraded at month-3 produces $900 credit; next 9 monthly invoices apply credit first; portal shows credit_remaining accurate.

new_units.title: Dunning state machine
new_units.spec: DunningStateMachineEngine: ACTIVE -> PAST_DUE -> GRACE -> READ_ONLY -> SUSPENDED -> CANCELED with configurable durations per tier, Stripe Smart Retries (d1/d3/d5/d7/d14), running-job exemption (in-flight CAM jobs allowed to finish before READ_ONLY), data-export window before terminal state.
new_units.acceptance: State transitions logged; READ_ONLY blocks new operations but allows job completion; SUSPENDED triggers 30d data-export grace; reactivation-on-payment within 14d preserves grandfather.

new_units.title: Offline CAM-plugin JWT license
new_units.spec: OfflineLicenseJwtEngine: PRISM-signed JWT (ES256) containing seat_id + exp + entitlements + nonce, plugin caches token + refreshes when online, runs up to N days (configurable per tier) offline, CRL pulled on reconnect.
new_units.acceptance: Plugin validates token offline; expired token blocks features; revoked token in CRL blocks on next online check; air-gapped 7-day operation test passes.

new_units.title: Browser-to-plugin token bridge
new_units.spec: TokenBridgeEngine: web user logs in -> short-lived bridge token via deep-link or local-loopback handshake passes signed JWT to plugin; replaces username+password in plugin entirely.
new_units.acceptance: Web login -> launch plugin -> plugin receives JWT without secret prompt; bridge token TTL <=120s; replay of bridge token after consumption rejected.

new_units.title: Seat revoke + token revocation list
new_units.spec: SeatRevokeEngine: revoke triggers CRL update (state/shared/license-crl.json), offline-cache invalidation via push (online plugins) + pull-on-reconnect (offline plugins), in-flight job grace policy, audit-log entry.
new_units.acceptance: Revoke from admin UI; online plugin loses access within 30s via push; offline plugin loses access on next reconnect; running job allowed to complete with read-only output.

new_units.title: Seat transfer + history audit
new_units.spec: SeatTransferEngine: admin reassigns seat from user A to user B preserving seat-id continuity; full history table (seat_id, user_id, granted_at, revoked_at, reason) for SOC2 traceability and per-seat-license dispute resolution.
new_units.acceptance: Transfer preserves seat_id; history query returns chronological holders; SOC2 evidence pull shows who held seat X on date Y.

new_units.title: Multi-org membership
new_units.spec: MultiOrgEngine: single user can belong to N orgs with per-org tier+entitlements; active-org context in session; per-org billing isolation; user-leaves-org cleanup without affecting other org memberships.
new_units.acceptance: User in 3 orgs with different tiers gets correct entitlements per active-org context; leaving org A retains org B+C access; billing events scoped to org_id.

new_units.title: Pairwise test matrix generator
new_units.spec: PairwiseMatrixEngine: replaces ad-hoc 48/480 sampling with IPOG (in-parameter-order-general) pairwise coverage generator over (tier=5)x(provider=4)x(form_factor=4)x(currency=6) -> ~124 pair-covered cases + 12 highest-revenue triplets exhaustive.
new_units.acceptance: Generator emits test-case CSV; all 2-way interactions covered (verified by combinatorial check); top-12 triplets enumerated explicitly; CI consumes CSV and runs each case against subscription dispatcher.

new_units.title: Affiliate fraud heuristics + clawback
new_units.spec: AffiliateFraudEngine: heuristic stack (self-referral via IP/device-fingerprint match, cookie-stuffing via referrer-chain anomaly, refund-after-payout pattern), risk score per referral, auto-hold high-risk payouts for manual review, clawback policy on confirmed fraud + chargeback.
new_units.acceptance: Self-referral test case scored >0.8 risk; cookie-stuffing pattern detected; clawback creates Stripe credit-note reversing payout; all fraud events logged immutably.

summary.verdict: MS1 EXPANDED 18 to 43 — exceeds Round-2 recommended 32-40 ceiling by 3 units because the round-2 reviewer underestimated form-factor + multi-org work. Final 43 covers every Round-2 finding F-r2-a2-1..10 with explicit unit-level remediation. Webhook hardening: 3 units (Stripe verify, Stripe dispatch, Paddle RSA). Tax decomposed: 4 units (bridge, invoice render, VAT-ID, exempt). Compliance: 3 units (GDPR delete, SOC2 chain, retention/PCI). Subscription state: 6 units (proration, downgrade, grandfather, refund-math, chargeback, annual-credit). Form factor: 3 units (offline JWT, browser bridge, seat revoke). Variability: 1 unit (pairwise IPOG). Multi-seat: 3 units (revoke, transfer, multi-org). Anti-fraud: 1 unit. Plus dispatcher scaffold + dunning state machine.
most_urgent_3: U-SUB-19 Stripe webhook security primitives — addresses F-r2-a2-1 CRITICAL #1 revenue-exfil vector; nothing else in MS1 is safe until this lands
U-SUB-22 Stripe Tax bridge — addresses F-r2-a2-3 CRITICAL; 6-month custom-tax problem dissolves into managed-service integration, unblocks EU/UK/CA/AU GTM
U-SUB-28 SOC2 audit-log immutable chain — addresses F-r2-a2-6 HIGH; every other unit emits audit events to this, making it the foundational substrate for compliance + enterprise sale
summary.one_line: MS1 expanded 18 to 43 units; webhook hardening + tax decomposition + SOC2 audit-log are the 3 most-urgent — without them MS1 cannot ship safely regardless of how the other 40 units land.
